yt_title: He's Designing a Secret Garden For Her... Will She Ever Know? | Part 1
description: Leo has been secretly designing a magical garden inspired by his childhood memories with Chloe. He yearns to confess his feelings, but fear holds him back. Will he find the courage before it's too late?
